newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Price decline slows down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Price decline slows down.

text.p: Millfeed prices were steady to lower Friday amid signs at some locations the the market may be bottoming out after the recent slide in values.
"I think the bottom should be somewhere near this level," one dealer said.
Others, however, noted prices also appeared unlikely to recover significantly from current depressed levels in the short-term with demand not seen picking up until pastures start to dry out in July.
"It is going to be difficult to find any improvement in feed demand for two to three weeks at least," one dealer said.
There was also talk that weakness in Canada may prompt shipments to an already oversupplied north-east U.S. market.
"They (Ontario prices) have come down more than we have," one north-east U.S. dealer said.
Prices in the key Kansas City market appeared to be stabilising just below $60, a drop of almost $20 since the end of last month.
